entities.name: Robert T. Van Horn
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Robert Thompson Van Horn was an American lawyer, the owner and publisher of The Kansas City Enterprise, the 6th mayor of Kansas City, Missouri during parts of the Civil War, a member of the Missouri General Assembly, and a representative of Missouri's 5th, 6th, and 8th congressional districts.
